Items.Question: Where are you from?
Items.ModelAnswer: I'm from Hanoi, the capital city of Vietnam. It's a vibrant city with a rich history spanning over a thousand years.
Items.Vocabulary: vibrant (sôi động), rich history (lịch sử phong phú), spanning (kéo dài)
Items.Tips: Nhấn mạnh 'Hanoi' và 'capital city'. Dùng ngữ điệu tự tin, không đọc vẹt.

Items.Question: Do you work or study?
Items.ModelAnswer: I'm currently working as a software developer at a tech company. I've been there for about three years now, and I really enjoy the collaborative environment.

Segments.Text: I've been there for about three years now
and I really enjoy the collaborative environment

Items.Vocabulary: software developer (lập trình viên), collaborative environment (môi trường cộng tác)
Items.Tips: Phát âm rõ 'software developer'. Dùng hiện tại hoàn thành 'I've been there' để chỉ thời gian.

Items.Question: What do you like about your hometown?
Items.ModelAnswer: What I love most about Hanoi is the street food culture. You can find delicious pho, bun cha, and banh mi on almost every corner. The energy of the Old Quarter at night is just incredible.

Segments.Text: What I love most about Hanoi
The energy of the Old Quarter at night

Items.Vocabulary: street food culture (văn hóa ẩm thực đường phố), Old Quarter (phố cổ), incredible (phi thường)
Items.Tips: Phát âm đúng 'pho', 'bun cha', 'banh mi'. Nhấn mạnh 'What I love most' để thể hiện cảm xúc.

Items.Question: Do you enjoy reading?
Items.ModelAnswer: Yes, I'm an avid reader. I usually read for about 30 minutes before bed. I'm particularly fond of science fiction and psychology books — they help me unwind and expand my perspective.

Segments.Text: I usually read for about 30 minutes before bed
I'm particularly fond of science fiction
they help me unwind and expand my perspective

Items.Vocabulary: avid reader (người say mê đọc sách), unwind (thư giãn), expand perspective (mở rộng quan điểm), fond of (thích)
Items.Tips: Dùng 'avid reader' thay vì 'I like reading' để tăng từ vựng. Liên kết ý với 'they help me...'.

Items.Question: What's your favorite weather?
Items.ModelAnswer: I prefer cool, dry weather — around 20 to 22 degrees Celsius. It's perfect for outdoor activities like jogging or cycling. Hot and humid weather really drains my energy.

Segments.Text: Hot and humid weather really drains my energy

Items.Vocabulary: cool, dry weather (thời tiết mát khô), humid (ẩm ướt), drains my energy (làm hao tổn năng lượng)
Items.Tips: Phát âm 'Celsius' rõ ràng. Dùng 'drains my energy' thay cho 'makes me tired' để tự nhiên hơn.
